trajectory_summary: The call is a short, mechanical verify-and-book pass that starts from confusion, gathers usable qualification data (30/40-year residence, bill of $500-700, all-electric, BGE), and ends without a locked appointment — the rep only secures a promise to text a bill photo. Energy is flat throughout: no scope creep, no objection resolved because none was truly raised, but also no appointment set, no interest-reason follow-up, and an unexplained supervisor hold that added confusion rather than resolving it cleanly.

This is a no_appointment outcome: the call ends on a bill-collection promise, not a scheduled consult.
